name: Mighty Duck 73
author: mrhyddenn
description: Rounded dark cyan get started button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, transform becomes translateY(4px) translateX(4px), box-shadow becomes #094c66 0px 0px 0px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mighty Duck 73</title>
<style>
/* Mighty Duck 73 by mrhyddenn — https://uiverse.io/mrhyddenn/mighty-duck-73 */
button {
  background-color: #1197cc;
  box-shadow: #094c66 4px 4px 0px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 15px 10px;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 15px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  min-width: 120px;
  transition: transform 200ms, box-shadow 200ms;
}

button:active {
  transform: translateY(4px) translateX(4px);
  box-shadow: #094c66 0px 0px 0px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    GET STARTED
</button>

</body>
</html>
